name: Machine-Discovery Surface Engineering
summary: Design public websites so search engines, LLM crawlers and direct agents can discover truthful capabilities through canonical HTML, robots, sitemap, machine JSON, agent guidance and stable metadata without exposing private payloads.
problem: A human-readable website can be technically public while agents cannot reliably discover its capabilities, or discoverability work can leak private payloads and invent unsupported commerce metadata.
coreOutcomes: Crawler policy with named and wildcard intent
Truthful structured data aligned to commercial state
requirements: A public website or capability surface
Control of robots and sitemap outputs
Ability to emit machine-readable JSON or equivalent
boundaries: robots rules express permission, not guaranteed indexing or model ingestion
llms.txt or agents.txt are convenience surfaces, not universal standards
Do not invent price, review, rating, compatibility or availability
Do not expose full private prompt, skill, credential or customer payloads
Crawler access does not grant action authority
